cloudOfflineBody: Cached data and local queues are active. Pending operations will replay when cloud connectivity returns.
onlineReauthTitle: Local sign-in active · Online services paused
onlineReauthBody: Your local work stays open. Sign in again in your browser to restore online services without logging out.
onlineReauthPending: Complete sign-in in your browser. Your local session stays active while waiting.
onlineReauthWaitEnded: Stopped waiting. Your local session is unchanged; you can sign in again anytime.
onlineReauthTimeout: Browser sign-in timed out. Your local session is unchanged; try again when ready.
onlineReauthOpenFailed: Couldn't open your browser. Your local session is unchanged; check your browser settings and try again.
onlineReauthFailed: Couldn't restore online sign-in. Your local session is unchanged; try again later.
runtimeUnavailableBody: AI and local model writes are paused. The client will reconnect once Runtime is available.
